Variants.Content: Entry Weddings and funerals allow family ties to be confirmed in public. Weddings in the Seven Gods region often involve exchanging vows in a church or in front of a heart tree. Nobles will use dowries, seats and guests to write politics into the ceremony; the funerals of the old gods in the North place more emphasis on tombs, fire and ancestors.
